subject: SOC2: VM scan cadence + 60-day CVE remediation proofpack request
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finlender.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finlender.com
Date: Fri, 17 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 evidence request — VM scan cadence and 60-day remediation attestation

Hi Karthik,

As part of our SOC2 review (we are the external assessor for FinLender), we need a short evidence packet that covers Redwood's vulnerability management cadence and a formal attestation that CVEs classified as Critical/High are remediated within 60 days or that compensating controls are in place. Specifically we need: 1) the last three authenticated internal/network scan exports, 2) a current patch/manifest showing fixes for any CVE in the last 90 days, 3) a statement of your SLA for remediation windows and escalation path, and 4) an attestation letter we can include in the SOC2 binder.

Please let me know if you can provide this by EOD Monday (2028-03-20). If you have a standard proofpack for SIG/CAIQ use, that would work too — we just need verifiable artifacts (scan output, timestamps, owners).

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Security Program Manager
FinLender

Attachment placeholders: request_form.pdf (customer form)

Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — VM scan cadence and 60-day remediation attestation

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask. We can assemble a SOC2-ready proofpack and attest to the 60-day remediation commitment for Critical and High CVEs; below is the plan and the artifacts we'll include:  

- Scan exports: authenticated internal scans for 2028-02-15, 2028-02-28, 2028-03-10 (we'll attach JSON exports).
- Patch manifest: per-CVE rows with owner, patch date, mitigation steps and rollback notes (CSV).
- SLA/Process excerpt: excerpt of our VM playbook documenting triage windows and escalation (text).
- Attestation letter: signed PDF with the statement and signatory details.

Deliver by: 2028-03-20 EOD. If you need earlier, we can push a partial packet (scan exports + manifest) today.

Monica and Kimberly — can you confirm ownership? Monica: assemble the scan exports and patch manifest. Kimberly: please prepare the attestation PDF and include the process excerpt (two paragraphs).

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Alicia — attaching the proofpack and formal attestation as requested. Summary below; full artifacts attached.

Summary (key points):
- Scan cadence: authenticated internal VM scans run weekly; external scans run bi-weekly. We retain signed exports for 12 months. Attached: scan-report-20280228.json (sample export), plus two additional exports in the Drive link.
- Remediation SLA: Critical CVEs targeted for remediation within 7 calendar days; High within 60 calendar days. Exceptions for vendor-delivered patches are documented and compensated (temporary controls).
- Recent examples: CVE-2027-4216 (Critical) patched 2028-02-22 (6 days); CVE-2028-0110 (High) vendor patch applied day 52 with compensating firewall rule in place since day 2. See patch-manifest.csv for per-CVE timeline and owners.
- Attestation: I attest that, to the best of my knowledge, Redwood follows the stated cadence and remediation windows for Critical/High CVEs and maintains change-traceable artifacts suitable for SOC2 review.

Please find attached: vulnerability-evidence-60d.pdf (signed attestation), scan-report-20280228.json, patch-manifest.csv. Drive link for full exports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link

If you need this as a signed DocuSign envelope, let me know and we'll route it today.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
